name: prayer-dome
description: Prayer Dome web app and Android package

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:run: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.mobile:build:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:build:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.test: node tests/assistant.test.js && node tests/content.test.js && node tests/academy.test.js && node tests/admin.test.js && node tests/certificate.test.js && node tests/pages.test.js && node tests/premium.test.js && node tests/challenge.test.js && node tests/certificates.test.js && node tests/devotional.test.js && node tests/geo.test.js && node tests/media.test.js && node tests/vercel.test.js
scripts.functions:verify: npm --prefix functions install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix functions run verify
scripts.verify:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run functions:verify
